Name: Bachelor Program of Communication Technology, Public Relations Major (Chương trình cử nhân ngành Công nghệ Truyền thông, chuyên ngành Quan hệ công chúng)
English Name: Bachelor Program of Communication Technology, Public Relations Major

PLOs.Name: PLO1
PLOs.Description: Have basic knowledge of social sciences, political law, national security and defense, contributing to the formation of worldview and scientific methodology.

PLOs.Name: PLO2
PLOs.Description: Possess a thorough understanding of knowledge ranging from foundational to advanced in multimedia communication, as well as knowledge of culture, psychology, and human behavior.

PLOs.Name: PLO3
PLOs.Description: Possess knowledge in researching, planning, implementing, managing, and evaluating public relations plans, as well as plans for producing media publications to support these initiatives.

PLOs.Name: PLO4
PLOs.Description: Have knowledge in applying and utilizing tools, software, and artificial intelligence for data analysis and media production to support public relations plans.

PLOs.Name: PLO5
PLOs.Description: Proficient in English for communication and learning (equivalent to level 4 of the six-level Vietnamese foreign language proficiency framework), with the ability to engage in simple conversations in Chinese.

PLOs.Name: PLO6
PLOs.Description: Possess creative thinking and problem-solving skills for complex situations, along with the capability to lead entrepreneurial ventures to create jobs for oneself and others.

PLOs.Name: PLO7
PLOs.Description: Possess the ability to research, plan, implement, manage, and evaluate public relations strategies and media production plans to support these initiatives and ensure work quality.

PLOs.Name: PLO8
PLOs.Description: Possess the ability to persuade target audiences and negotiate with stakeholders using scientific arguments and creative ideas to build and manage the reputation of a brand, business, or organization.

PLOs.Name: PLO9
PLOs.Description: Work independently and collaboratively in both academic and practical environments; possess strong mental and physical resilience, demonstrate national identity, confidently integrate into the global community, and consistently exhibit ethical behavior, social responsibility, and a spirit of community service in all situations.

PLOs.Name: PLO10
PLOs.Description: Have a self-learning mindset to adapt to technological and societal changes, along with the ability to self-direct, draw professional conclusions, defend personal viewpoints, plan, guide, manage implementation, and evaluate the effectiveness of plans.
